name: Scan Evaluations
summary: Chronos — what your scans can and can't see. Per asset: credential health from the Target Credential Status / Issues plugins (104410 failed, 110385/102094 insufficient privilege, 117885 intermittent, 110723 none provided, 141118/110095 OK) and plugin 19506, patch-assessment failures (21745), scan freshness, agent vs network, crown-jewel blind spots. Per scanner / policy / scan: time per asset, load share, credential success, Nessus version and plugin-feed currency, safe-checks off. Tags the exact assets under Scan Health (gated).
